intervals.label: data taking at TRIUMF (data from 2004 onwards)
intervals.note: Start is a lower bound (the 2004 data set); the full data-taking period is not stated in a source consulted. End is an upper bound: the 22-24 October 2010 paper says the collaboration "has completed a new measurement".
intervals.quote: The results presented here supersede those results and are based on an analysis of data taken in 2004

intervals.label: completed
intervals.note: Upper bound on the end of the experiment.
intervals.quote: The TWIST Collaboration has completed a new measurement of the energy-angle spectrum of positrons from the decay of highly polarized muons.

placements.note: TRIUMF campus-grade site; the M13 area is not located in a fetched source.
placements.quote: The muons from pions that decayed on the surface of the target were transported by the M13 surface muon channel to the detector

summary.plain: A stack of very thin wire chambers in a magnetic field that tracks the positrons from the decays of muons stopped in the middle.
summary.technical: Planar drift and proportional chamber stack in a solenoid measuring the positron momentum and angle from polarized surface-muon decay; details not recorded because no source consulted gives them.
